summary: Teton Range peak that the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists among its unknown or undocumented sites; no source describes a lookout on it.

facts.status_note: Listed as an unknown or undocumented site; no source describes a lookout structure there.

visit.trail_note: Hiking route from the Coal Creek Trailhead on US 22 to the summit, about 10 miles round trip; no lookout is described on it.

evidence.supports: FFLA lists a Taylor Mountain site in Teton County
Site filed under the Unknown/Undocumented Sites heading
Listed sites move to the lookout lists if documented as regular lookouts
evidence.quote: If evidence or documentation is uncovered showing that any of these were actually used as regular wildland fire lookout sites, they will be moved to the lookout lists.

evidence.supports: Peak in the Teton Range, about two miles northwest of Teton Pass, close to Wilson and Jackson
evidence.quote: Taylor Mountain is located in the Teton Range about two miles northwest of Teton Pass and close to Wilson and Jackson Wyoming.
From Wilson, Wyoming, drive west on US 22 7.5 miles to the Coal Creek Trailhead

evidence.supports: Trailhead just west of Teton Pass
evidence.quote: just west of Teton Pass on the north side of the road
From the ridge, leave the trail and follow Taylor Mountain's north ridge to its summit.

evidence.supports: Forest adding lookout stations in the early 1940s; notice dated April 1941
Four new lookout houses being built in 1941
evidence.quote: constructing four new lookout houses for the Teton National Forest
Eleven new fire lookout stations were created this year, giving a total of 17 stations.

evidence.supports: Teton Forest deemed it advisable to man the Monument Ridge and Munger Mountain lookouts in July 1954 (not confirmed as manned)
evidence.quote: has deemed it advisable to man the Monument Ridge and Munger Mountain lookouts.

evidence.supports: Five more Teton Forest positions named to be manned within the next week
evidence.quote: Other lookout positions on the Teton Forest which will be manned within the next week are at Huckleberry Mountain, Baldy Mountain, Hawks Rest, Two-Ocean Plateau, and Deer Creek Point.

sources.title: Huckleberry Mountain - FOREST LOOKOUTS (quoting the Jackson Hole Courier)

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source that names this site is the FFLA Wyoming list, under Unknown/Undocumented Sites, with coordinates matching the record. The cache has no NHLR or FFLOS entry for a Wyoming Taylor Mountain lookout, and two searches found no description of a structure on the peak. The SummitPost page is a climbing guide, cited only for location and the hiking route. Do not confuse with the Idaho Taylor Mountain lookout pages in the cache (data/raw/nhlr/nhlr.org/lookouts/us/id/taylor-mountain-lookout and data/raw/firelookout_com/id/taylormtn321.html). The 1941, 1942 and 1954 Courier notices are regional context: they do not name this site. The editor may cut that middle paragraph if it reads as padding. Access and remains are unknown.
